author: rakesh.shukla
description: On-demand agent. The user signs in to GitHub (SSO + authenticator); the agent then opens each configured repo's Settings > Collaborators and teams, clicks Direct access, filters Role = Admin, adds a highlighted date/time banner and saves a screenshot. Screenshots are zipped per run.

outputs.zip: <agent name> <YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.zip (this run's screenshots, in the output folder)

safety: Human performs authentication; no credentials are stored or handled by the agent
Aborts on GitHub restriction/rate-limit page; never retries or evades it

changelog.notes: Initial release. Derived from Branch Specific Write Access 1.1.0 (login, Okta/SSO wait, restriction abort, pacing, highlighted banner, run zip) with an added Direct access > Role = Admin filter step (configurable via --role or inputs.role).
